Package ui

Class InventoryUsagePane

java.lang.Object
ui.InventoryUsagePane
public class InventoryUsagePane extends Object
Inventory Usage report: how much of each inventory item was used between two dates. Usage is quantity sold times servings_used. Refunded sales are counted because the drink was still made. The chart shows the most used items; the table under it lists every item.
